scope: Two original asset Event0 prefixes only. Complete native bodies and explicit script call/return frames, including the intervening native motion-table summaries. No script/game execution.
preconditions: Original stored code and native descriptor tables remain unchanged; actual loading follows the shown Actor setup path.
The native allocator succeeds with distinct valid work/frame/temp buffers and a valid Actor object; Ptr32 encode/decode round-trips the involved pointers.
The script, name strings, VM stacks and shared work remain live and are not concurrently or reentrantly modified.
Covered native calls return normally; stack-cookie/error/exception failures are outside the continuing path.

Native runtime float compatibility adjustments are not emulated. They do not select the wrapper addresses or immediate resource IDs in these prefixes; numeric motion fields are not asserted identical to stored values.
method: A fail-closed symbolic evaluator accepts only encountered operations; models tagged pointer provenance and actual frame-size/return-PC slots. It resolves all concrete nested calls and branches, summarizes four identified native adapters, checks bounded motion strings/record destinations, and checks all256 values of the one native byte input. Unknown operations fail verification.
limits: No inference from Event0 to Motion Event27 or a different caller.
No universal script emulator or complete game/task/thread/lifetime proof.
No unconditional asset execution or native rebind success claim.
No raw asset package copied; only bounded decoded prefixes, small BAR spans and hashes.
The native1:6 extra scratch-slot reads are real but their live values and visible behavior remain unknown.
